verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs show a consistent set of core primitives (CLI, REST API, serverless functions, database, edge functions, SDK) usable from a first anonymous deploy through production teams, and docs-18 claims security 'at any scale,' suggesting some platform continuity. However there is no explicit documentation or independent evidence addressing architectural continuity as usage scales to 'massive' levels, and billing/DDoS-cost community reports (ignored here as off-topic to API/primitive continuity) hint at scale-related friction that isn't directly refuted. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement on avoiding re-architecture at scale, case studies of large-scale sites still using the same core APIs, and independent corroboration of seamless scaling without platform migration.
